13-the-porch.title: The porch
13-the-porch.narration: {{chloe-jenkins}} dug through her bag for her keys while {{sam-hayes}} read the message again under the porch bulb. Six hours. He had read it at 11:52.
13-the-porch.visualDescription: two women on a narrow front porch at night, one bent over a phone, one at the door

14-read-at-1152.title: Read at 11:52
14-read-at-1152.narration: {{theo-vance:full}} signed contracts with his whole name. He signed {{sam-hayes:formal}} with one letter. Across town, {{brass-key}} stayed {{brass-key:attitude}}.
14-read-at-1152.visualDescription: {{sam-hayes:full}} at a kitchen table under lamplight, phone glowing, contact name '{{theo-vance:full}}' on screen

15-across-town.title: Across town
15-across-town.narration: {{theo-vance}} turned the phone face down on the workbench. {{brass-key}} was {{brass-key:attitude}}, where it always was.
15-across-town.visualDescription: a man alone in a workshop under a hanging bulb, phone face down beside him
